probe_finding: Definition (deep-scroll catalog, 2026-10-15): unrealized air yards per route run — the air yards a receiver's targets carried that did NOT convert into completions/yards, normalized per route run; @StephenKrupka publishes it for the top-25 WRs/TEs (PFF data). Role in-engine: it measures downfield opportunity that exists but is unconverted — the opportunity half of a deep-threat read, distinct from C-303 (which weights the targets that were earned) and from raw aDOT (which says nothing about volume per route). A receiver high here is being sent deep and targeted deep without the completions landing: scheme/role signal first, efficiency verdict only with the conversion context beside it.
